title: Rent-A-Girlfriend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a painful breakup, college student Kazuya Kinoshita rents a girlfriend, Chizuru Mizuhara, through a dating-service app. To keep up appearances with his hospitalized grandmother and friends he keeps renting her, and he gradually falls for her and tries to turn the fake relationship into a real one.
life_message: A good life means moving from pretense toward sincere, committed love.
